<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—dominant peak at m/z ≈199, a nearly equal intensity peak at m/z ≈201 (M+2), and a much smaller M+1 peak—the characteristic 1:1 M:M+2 pattern points to bromine, whose two main isotopes (^79Br and ^81Br) appear in roughly equal abundance. No other element shows such a definitive pattern in the data.</thought>
<final_answer>['Br']</final_answer>
